newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher but momentum seen fading.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher but momentum seen fading.

text.p: The British stock market opened firmer on Thursday, taking strength from Wall Street's strong close overnight and favourable corporate results.

But dealers said early momentum, which saw the FTSE 100 share index push as high as 3,953.0 points, faded amid renewed worries about inflation, interest rates and a major options bet on a market crash. Weak gilts also hit sentiment.
Some 20 minutes after the start of trade, the FTSE had drifted back to 3,932.6 points, down 3.1 on the day.
"We had a celebratory mark-up on Wall Street but I don't think it is likely to keep going," a senior equities dealer said.
